description: Job search: find open jobs (remote, by title, location or pay) across about 20,000 company job boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee, Workday), crawled twice a day: about 470,000 jobs. Filter by title words, company, location, remote, minimum yearly salary, posting age and level (entry-level / new grad, or internships). Returns up to 50 newest matches with company, location, remote flag, salary when published, posting date and link. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

level.description: entry: intern, co-op, new-grad, junior and similar titles (no senior ones); intern: internships and co-ops

minSalary.description: Minimum yearly pay, in currency; only jobs that publish pay

postedWithinDays.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days (1-365)

title.description: Words in the job title; comma-separate alternatives (data engineer,analytics engineer)

name: jobs_search

notes.description: string, e.g. "Newest first. Searches open jobs on ~20,000 company job boa
